ambient_events: A cell door stands open on a made bed nobody has slept in.
Somebody writes a first name in the ledger and does not write a surname.
The fire is fed one log and left alone.
description: The only building in the compound whose door is propped, and it is propped with a stone that has clearly lived there for years. A water butt beside it with a dipper on a chain, and the chain is not there to stop anybody taking the dipper, it is there so the dipper does not get lost.
name: The Open Door
